## Project case studies

- [AI/LLM Drafting Platform](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/funding-request-drafting): The first true agentic AI platform approved for production at the bank; launched across the full CFO Group in all geographies in May 2026.
- [AI/LLM Workforce Analytics Platform](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/workforce-analytics): Built March–November 2025; production financial analytics with model-mediated language work around code-owned entitlement and calculation.
- [Financial Peer Benchmarking Platform](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/financial-peer-benchmarking): One production product across v1 and its two-week v2 text-to-SQL refactor.
- [Commodity Tax](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/commodity-tax): PySpark and Tableau process automation that reduced a months-long workflow to 90 minutes for a roughly $600M allocation.
- [Document Intelligence](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/document-intelligence): A hybrid component that improved checkbox-detection accuracy from roughly 70% to 99.95%; this is not an end-to-end pipeline score.
- [Combustion Tuning](https://rogerthatroach.github.io/projects/combustion-tuning): 84 regression models and bounded PSO for operator-reviewed settings on one 900 MW Maizuru unit; $3M in annual savings.

## Evidence boundaries

- Exactly three production AI systems at RBC: AI/LLM drafting, AI/LLM workforce analytics, and financial peer benchmarking. Commodity Tax is process automation; a separate weekend prototype is not production.
- The AI/LLM drafting platform’s production version has one LangGraph orchestration scope. Its bounded tool routines are not independent agents.
- The regulated-finance systems use approved foundation-model endpoints; no fine-tuning work is claimed.
- Model and retrieval scores route review or clarification. They are not correctness guarantees.
